budget_items.topic: Housing Production Plan conversion to Master Plan Housing Element
budget_items.what_was_recorded: Converting the HPP into a Master Plan Housing Element was estimated at approximately $1,000.00, probably in December; the HPP takes 5-6 months.
budget_items.quote: it can be converted into a master plan housing element probably in december

budget_items.what_was_recorded: The Transportation Element was estimated to take approximately $8,000 to $10,000; the Board was advised to start it in May 2015 using encumbered funds.
The Planning Board may be eligible for additional funding under UPWP, which would be available late summer/early fall.
budget_items.quote: planning board may be eligible for additional funding under upwp

budget_items.what_was_recorded: The Economic Development Element contract concluded, and funding is not available if the Board wants major reconfiguration of the document; no dollar figure printed.
budget_items.quote: the contract for the economic development element concluded
